messages:
Tony (Support): Heads up -- Novapulse trial hit a sustained embed throttle during onboarding, user-facing timeouts and a stalled activation. They called this morning and said if it isn't resolved in 48h they're likely to pause the pilot. @Maria can you take this? :exclamation:
Sara (CS): Ack, reassigning to CS. Can you paste the error / sample log and the tenant id?
Tony (Support): Tenant ID: novapulse-prod-42. Error snippets below from our logs:

```
ERROR 2026-03-15T09:12:01Z embed-service quota_exceeded tenant=novapulse-prod-42 rate=620/s limit=500/s
timeout sending request to embedder: context deadline exceeded
```

Tony (Support): Also seeing a jump in concurrent embed requests from their integration tests (~6x normal). They said they started ramping docs ingestion yesterday.
Maria (CSM): Thanks. Primary risk: stalled activation -> renewal signal. Proposed comms plan: 1) immediate quicknote to Novapulse PM acknowledging escalation + ETA for fix, 2) schedule 30m troubleshooting with eng & cs within next 6 hours, 3) offer temporary rate-limited fallback guidance until we restore capacity, 4) follow-up summary + prevention steps. I can own customer comms if CS approves.
Sara (CS): Agree with plan. Maria, please own the message. James, can eng join the call and confirm root cause + short-term mitigation?
James (Engineer): I can join. Quick analysis: looks like our per-tenant burst guard kicked in because their ingestion burst exceeded the prefix-based burst credit. We default to 500/s for this tenant profile; embedders on X fleet are near capacity in us-west-2. Short-term: we can temporarily raise their soft limit to 1k/s for 24h and enable backpressure smoothing on their route to reduce spikes. Mid-term: recommend prefix caching + batching changes on their side and autoscale more embed workers for the cluster.
Maria (CSM): Perfect. For the immediate message to the customer I drafted this: 

"Hi Team Novapulse — thanks for flagging this. We're seeing throttling on your embed requests during a recent ingestion spike which caused timeouts. We're scheduling a troubleshooting session with our engineers in the next 6 hours and will temporarily increase your embed throughput while we investigate. We expect to have a mitigation in place within 24 hours. I'll follow up with a written summary and permanent recommendations after the call. — Maria, CSM"

Sara (CS): Looks good. Add a note offering a short demo of batching best practices to avoid reoccurrence.
Maria (CSM): Added. Sending now.
ops-bot: [reminder] Meeting created: #incident-novapulse-1764219999 at 2026-03-15T10:30:00Z; attendees: Maria, James, Tony, Sara
James (Engineer): On the call we can run a live trace and if we approve, I'll bump their soft limit and spin an extra embed worker. I'll post the command I'll use here before executing.
Tony (Support): Customer replied: "Thanks, appreciate the quick response. We'll be on the call at 10:30." They also asked for a temporary uplift to avoid blocking their sales demos.
Maria (CSM): Action items: - Maria: send the kickoff note (done) and run the call. - James: prepare ramp command and confirm rollback plan. - Tony: keep customer slack thread warm and capture any config changes they made that triggered the spike. - Sara: flag renewal risk to RevOps if we end up needing >24h mitigation.
Sara (CS): I'll open a renewal-risk flag if we hit 24h. Also capture sentiment change in account health dashboard.
James (Engineer): Ramp command (preview):

```
# preview only
kubectl patch configmap embed-quota --type=json -p='[{"op":"replace","path":"/tenants/novapulse-prod-42/soft_limit","value":1000}]'
# post-change monitor: /metrics?filter=tenant=novapulse-prod-42
```

James (Engineer): I'll wait for verbal ack on the call before running. Plan to revert to 500/s after 24h and recommend long-term config changes.
Maria (CSM): Friendly reminder to the group: keep communications simple for the customer, avoid deep infra details in the first note. We'll escalate the renewal path only if mitigation extends.
Tony (Support): Will capture any customer changes (ingest config) and add to the thread.
Sara (CS): Thanks team. I'll update the account health playbook after we close this with the final root cause & prevention steps. :thumbsup:
Maria (CSM): Post-call update will go to #customer-success and I'll attach notes to the account record.
Tony (Support): -- end thread --
